items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: To sit on the same bandstand with Alec Templeton was an honor.

ctx.x: I think. Officers Club at the NAS. It's Shipman. This... This... Algears Naval Base. Or... Some... You know, somewhere. I'd have to... I'd have to just go into all of the details to remember where they were. Yeah. This is at Blaise D'Antonis' home. This building was separate from his house. Does he have a swimming pool? This is home. Yeah, yeah. This is swimming pool. Sharky and Alec Templeton. Mm-hmm.
Now, that's on tape. I've heard that on tape.
